is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii (a member of the An. gambiae complex) collected in Chad.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west) and Vgsc L1014S (kdr-east) (Table 1, page 7) and Ace-1 G119S (page 5, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 on page 7 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for 1014F and 1014S kdr mutations for both N'djamena and Massakory populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in N'djamena and Massakory, Chad (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research article reporting original field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites as N'djamena and Massakory, Chad, with coordinates provided (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The collection occurred between 14th and 22nd of August 2018 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection of mosquitoes in 2018 for this research.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Anopheles coluzzii populations from N'djamena and Massakory, Chad, collected in 2018. It reports high pyrethroid and bendiocarb resistance, investigates metabolic resistance via synergist bioassays, and genotypes kdr (1014F/S) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations.
